# cengenAnnotate

`cengenAnnotate` automates annotation of Seurat clusters in C. elegans
single-cell data using [CeNGEN](https://www.cengen.org) reference
expression data. It replaces the manual workflow of copying marker genes
into the CeNGEN website, reading the resulting dot plot by eye, and
judging whether a cluster’s marker panel points to a single coherent
cell type.

`cengenAnnotate` computes a “dot-plot-mirrored coherence score” for
every (cluster, candidate cell type) pair directly from CeNGEN’s
unthresholded expression data (the same average-expression and
percent-expressing values a dot plot encodes as color and size), then
classifies each cluster as confidently annotatable or in need of manual
review, based on a tunable score cutoff and the gap to the next-best
candidate.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("cengenproject/cengenAnnotate")
```

## Workflow

``` r

library(Seurat)
library(cengenAnnotate)

# 1. Marker genes, as usual
markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, only.pos = TRUE)

# 2. Pick a CeNGEN reference dataset (stage/sex variant)
list_cengen_datasets()
reference <- load_cengen_reference("adult_herm")

# 3. Score every cluster against every candidate cell type
result <- score_cengen_clusters(markers, reference)
result

# 4. Write confident annotations back onto the Seurat object; ambiguous /
#    marker-poor clusters are left for manual review
seurat_obj <- write_cengen_annotations(seurat_obj, result)

# 5. Visually sanity-check any cluster, especially ones sent to review
plot_cengen_dotplot(reference, markers, cluster = "3", scores = result)
```

See
[`vignette("cengenAnnotate")`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/articles/cengenAnnotate.md)
for a complete walkthrough.

## Reference data

Reference datasets (developmental stage x sex variants of CeNGEN’s
unthresholded expression data) are published to the
[`cengen-reference-data`](https://github.com/cengenproject/cengen-reference-data)
repo as a [`pins`](https://pins.rstudio.com) board, so new datasets
become available to
[`list_cengen_datasets()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/list_cengen_datasets.md)/[`load_cengen_reference()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/load_cengen_reference.md)
without any changes to this package. See that repo’s README for the
dataset schema and how to publish a new dataset.

## Defaults are provisional

The default score `cutoff` (0.6) and `min_gap` (0.10) used by
[`score_cengen_clusters()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/score_cengen_clusters.md)
are reasonable starting points, not empirically calibrated thresholds.
Validate them against clusters with independently known identity before
relying on this package for unattended annotation.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cengen_board()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/cengen_board.md)
  : The CeNGEN reference-data pins board
- [`cengen_matrix()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/cengen_matrix.md)
  : Get the full cluster x cell-type score matrix
- [`classify_cengen_matches()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/classify_cengen_matches.md)
  : Classify clusters as annotatable or in need of review
- [`combine_with_transfer_data()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/combine_with_transfer_data.md)
  : Combine cengenAnnotate results with Seurat TransferData predictions
- [`list_cengen_datasets()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/list_cengen_datasets.md)
  : List available CeNGEN reference datasets
- [`load_cengen_reference()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/load_cengen_reference.md)
  : Load a CeNGEN reference dataset from the pins board
- [`new_cengen_reference()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/new_cengen_reference.md)
  : Construct a CeNGEN reference object
- [`plot_cengen_dotplot()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/plot_cengen_dotplot.md)
  : Plot a CeNGEN-style dot plot for one cluster's marker panel
- [`prepare_marker_panel()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/prepare_marker_panel.md)
  : Prepare a per-cluster marker gene panel
- [`score_cengen_clusters()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/score_cengen_clusters.md)
  : Score and classify clusters against CeNGEN cell types
- [`score_cengen_matrix()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/score_cengen_matrix.md)
  : Score clusters against every candidate CeNGEN cell type
- [`write_cengen_annotations()`](https://cengenproject.github.io/cengenAnnotate/reference/write_cengen_annotations.md)
  : Write CeNGEN annotations onto a Seurat object
